articles.summary: BEIJING, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Li Auto Inc. (“Li Auto” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: LI; HKEX: 2015), a leader in China’s new energy vehicle market, today announced that it delivered 37,679 vehicles in August 2026. As of August 31, 2026, Li Auto’s cumulative deliveries reached 1,801,834.
articles.title: Li Auto Inc. August 2026 Delivery Update
